RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

You are a man, the successful candidate is a man, and the panel was all men. An all-male panel can disadvantage women; it is very hard to argue it disadvantaged you. Raising it would likely read as grasping and undermine your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are stronger: a specific, documented role requirement set (PhD-level modelling vs. a master's in finance), the vagueness of "broad experience of regulatory affairs," and the employer's failure to respond to your request for written reasons within two weeks.

Send a firm follow-up asking for the scoring criteria, your scores, and the panel's notes. If the criteria were never fixed in advance, that is your real issue.
